latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Modularity Health Evaluator skill:

- Provides quantitative assessment of code modularity using metrics: LCOM (Lack of Cohesion of Methods), afferent/efferent coupling, abstractness, instability, distance from main sequence, and connascence taxonomy.
- Supports analysis of classes, packages, components, and services using both codebase scans and user descriptions.
- Guides users to assess structural health before code refactoring, microservice extraction, or architectural migration.
- Offers clear process: identifies target modules, gathers responsibilities and dependencies, estimates cohesion, and evaluates coupling.
- Suggests default assumptions and sufficiency thresholds to proceed even with partial information.
